title: Incremental backups
subtitle: Encrypted restore points: each backup stores only what changed
keyHelp: Every restore point is encrypted with this key. Without it nobody can read the backups, not you and not us, and a lost server takes the key with it. Download it and keep it somewhere other than this server.
keySaved: I have saved the key somewhere else
notConfigured: Not set up yet. Choose where the restore points go.
notConfiguredUser: Incremental backups are not set up on this server yet.
existingPasswordHelp: Leave empty to create a new repository with a new key.

kindHelp.local: Safe from mistakes, not from losing the disk. Prefer storage on another machine.
kindHelp.sftp: drust logs in with root's SSH key; add it to the backup server first.
kindHelp.s3: The keys are stored encrypted and only given to restic.
kindHelp.rclone: Set up the remote first with rclone config as root.

restorePointsHelp: Each one holds the website's files and databases as they were at that moment.
